## Write a blog post

1. Copy `blog/posts/_template/` to `blog/posts/YYYY-MM-DD-short-name/`.
2. Write your post in `index.qmd` (plain Markdown is fine).
3. Open a pull request.

Not comfortable with GitHub? [Open an issue](https://github.com/crest-science/crest-science.github.io/issues/new/choose) with your text and we will publish it for you.

## Suggest a reference

[Open an issue](https://github.com/crest-science/crest-science.github.io/issues/new/choose) using the "Suggest a reference" template.
